'''Greist''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
[[General/Legends|General]] Greist participated in the [[Cleansing of Nopsin]] along with his men [[Phenter]] and [[Pierce]], he chose to promote the former to the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]], leaving Pierce a mere [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. Pierce did not mind, as he found Greist stubborn and did not get well alongside him, being transferred away shorty after.<ref name="Reallocation" />

In [[3640 BBY]], General Greist was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] where he led the [[Armageddon Battalion]], supposed to supplement the war effort on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], but redirected from battlefield by [[Darth Baras]]. He and Phenter were approached by the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], who ordered them to abandon Baras' orders and lead the Armageddon Battalion to Corellia. However, due to his stubborn nature, Greist was [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choked]] to death by the Wrath under [[Servant One]]'s command.<ref name="Reallocation" />

==Personality and traits==
Pierce, who had briefly served with General Greist, described him as a stubborn character.<ref name="Reallocation" />

==Behind the scenes==
Greist is a character in the 2011 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game.<ref name="Reallocation" />

Greist's fate can be decided two ways. The player can use Force-choke and kill him or convince the general to take his battalion to Corellia. Neither option grants light side or dark side points.<ref name="Reallocation" />

If the player has Pierce as the active companion, he warns the General that people who disobey the Wrath end up dead, but Greist dismisses the threat. The player can then kill Greist, earning dark side points and a significant amount of Pierce's affection.<ref name="Reallocation" />
